fixture.title: Tesla — reference components
fixture.description:
Reference fixture for design-systems/tesla. Radical
        subtraction: pure-white canvas, single Electric Blue accent,
        Universal Sans typography capped at 40px, 0.33s universal
        transitions, and viewport-scale whitespace as the dominant
        composition device.

selectors: * Silver Fog placeholder. The fixture binds a faint --border * box so the input is visible against the pale section * background; focus tightens to --accent and adds the soft blue * halo. Density is quiet — photography is supposed to dominate * the page
* so we keep .badge present in the fixture for completeness * (system-status indicator on the hero side panel) but bind it * to the muted neutral tier by default. */ .badge

/* ─── Nav link / text link ─────────────────────────────────── * Tertiary "Learn / Order / Experience" tier from DESIGN.md §4 * — 14px Pewter

/* ─── Typography — weight 400/500 only; no bold ever ──────── */ h1
